The proposed answer (33, 47) rests on a "known fact" that I can't verify, so I can't confirm it.

The 3D comparison is right: the 230 space groups reduce to 219 abstract isomorphism classes, because of the enantiomorphic pairs. The subperiodic numbers are not supported by any derivation in the proposed solution, and I don't reliably recall the published counts for rod and layer groups under abstract isomorphism. The solution doesn't compute anything, so its specific values are unverified.

VERDICT: REJECT
